review.tagline: TypeScript framework for building MCP servers with React Views and an Inspector
review.summary: mcp-use is a TypeScript v2 framework, built on the official MCP TypeScript SDK, for writing MCP servers with Zod-typed tools. It binds React Views to tools so they render as interactive apps in hosts such as ChatGPT and Claude. It ships a dev Inspector, a headless client CLI, a View screenshot command, tunneling, and a deploy command targeting Manufact.
review.audience: TypeScript developers building MCP servers and ChatGPT or Claude apps
strengths: Zod schemas flow from tool input and output into React View props
Inspector served at /mcp/inspector in dev; headless CLI can call tools and screenshot Views
Built-in tunnel (mcp-use dev --tunnel) for testing in ChatGPT and Claude before deploy
MIT licensed, with a self-hosting guide alongside the hosted option
weaknesses: v2 is a breaking change from v1; a migration guide is needed
Benchmark and comparison figures are the project's own, not independent
One-command npm run deploy targets the vendor's Manufact platform
Example apps live in separate repos, not in the main package
